posts.title: wrongfooted by history (Dave McCullough on Kraftwerk's Computer World)
posts.description: A strange, irritable, almost itchy kind of review by Dave McC, as if trying to think up reasons why it wasn't a great record Actually I remember feeling unimpressed by "Pocket Calculator" at the time But "Computer Love" and "Home Computer" make this is a stone classic - worth far more than the tepid three stars bestowed
